_comment: Content sprint — 200 Higgsfield credits ($12), TOPPED UP 2026-06-02. discipline.calibrate_first: NO batch generation until Phase 0 calibration passes Paul's likeness/quality review. This is the answer to 'don't generate a bunch that doesn't look like me.'
discipline.batch_review: generate in batches of 2-4 -> Telegram -> Paul keeps/regens -> only the proven recipe scales
discipline.budget: 200cr total, hard reserve, every keeper flows through Flow 1 (gate -> Maya caption -> publish-ready)

phase_0_calibration.what: 2 test Logan clips on the BEST inputs (cleanest full-body Logan still from ~/reed-dump/logan-stills/ + one clean ~/boxing-corpus/ motion-ref), via Higgsfield Kling motion-control.
phase_0_calibration.gate: Send both to Paul's Telegram. PROCEED only if he confirms likeness + quality. If off-model: adjust recipe (different still / settings / soul-id 2a825762 long-dreadlocks) and re-test BEFORE any scaling. Calibration credits come out of the Logan track.

track_A_logan.focus: animated Logan assets (motion-control clips), character input = the 31 existing clean stills, motion ref = boxing corpus. Includes the 12cr Phase-0 calibration.

items.item: frequency-state stills (Lapis/BlackLight/Fluorescent) — only stills not already in the 31-image library

track_A_logan.note: 84cr of new Track-A gens + 12cr Phase-0 calibration = 96cr Logan total.

track_B_maya.focus: BR content stills driven by Maya's content plan (maya-content-plan.json -> maya-plan.js -> image-requests.json). Lower Paul-likeness risk than Logan; still batch-reviewed + gated + captioned.
